web-design.title: Web Design
web-design.subtitle: Custom websites that perform as good as they look. Built in Dubai since 2015.
web-design.lede: Your website is not a brochure. It is your hardest-working employee: selling, explaining and representing you 24 hours a day.
web-design.body: We do not use templates. We do not drag and drop. Every site we deliver is a bespoke piece of engineering, hand-coded, rigorously tested, and built for speed.
aside: Lighthouse score. We treat anything below perfect as a bug.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: We start by understanding your business, your audience, and your goals. No assumptions, just questions until we see the full picture.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Wireframes become high-fidelity mockups. You see exactly what you are getting before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: Clean, semantic, performant code. We build component by component, testing on every device and browser as we go.

steps.title: Launch & Support
steps.text: DNS, SSL, analytics, structured data: we handle the details. Post-launch, we stay on call for edits and enhancements.

faqs.a: We build with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Our sites are deployed on Vercel for global edge performance. For CMS needs we integrate Sanity, Contentful, or headless WordPress.

Every website we build includes technical SEO foundations: structured data, semantic HTML, Core Web Vitals optimization, meta tags, and XML sitemaps. We also offer ongoing SEO strategy as an add-on service.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the pages, features, content and languages you need. Fill in the project brief to see a live estimate as you answer, and after a short call we send a fixed quote so there are no surprises.

branding.title: Brand Identity
branding.subtitle: Logos are the tip of the iceberg. We build the whole iceberg.
branding.lede: A brand is not a logo. A brand is a promise: the sum of every interaction your audience has when they encounter you.
branding.body: We have built identities for DJs, restaurants, tech startups, photographers, and luxury service providers across Dubai and beyond. The common thread is substance. Every brand we create has a reason to exist.
aside: Before we design anything, we ask the uncomfortable questions. Who are you for? Who are you not for? What do you believe that your competitors do not?

process.title: Immersion
process.text: We study your industry, your competitors, and your audience. We interview you. We absorb everything before forming an opinion.

process.title: Strategy
process.text: We define your positioning, personality, and messaging framework. This becomes the brief that guides all creative work.

process.title: Design Exploration
process.text: We present 2 to 3 distinct creative directions. Not variations of the same idea, but genuinely different approaches to your identity.

process.title: Refinement & Delivery
process.text: The chosen direction is refined, systematised, and documented in a brand guidelines package you can hand to any designer or printer.

included.title: Brand Strategy
included.text: Audience definition, competitive positioning, brand personality, tone of voice, and core messaging. The foundation everything else is built on.

included.title: Logo System
included.text: Primary logo, secondary mark, favicon, and responsive variations. Designed to work at every size, from a billboard to an app icon.

included.title: Visual Identity
included.text: Colour palette with Pantone and hex codes, typography system with primary and secondary typefaces, photography direction, and pattern/texture library.

included.title: Brand Guidelines
included.text: A comprehensive document that ensures consistency long after we are done. Logo usage rules, spacing, colour applications, do and do-not examples, and templates.

faqs.q: What does a brand identity package include?
faqs.a: Our standard package includes brand strategy and positioning, primary and secondary logo designs, colour palette, typography system, brand guidelines document, and a starter kit of templates. We tailor each package to the client.

Yes. Every branding project starts with strategy. We define your audience, positioning, tone of voice, and competitive differentiation before touching a single pixel. Strategy without design is a document. Design without strategy is decoration.

meta.title: Brand Identity Dubai — Logo & Branding · True Love Creative
meta.description: Premium brand identity design in Dubai. Logo design, brand strategy, visual systems, and brand guidelines from a studio that builds identities with substance.

graphic-design.title: Graphic Design
graphic-design.subtitle: Vinyl covers, event flyers, and visual systems for artists who refuse to blend in.
graphic-design.lede: We come from the music industry. A decade inside Dubai's nightlife, studio and events scene, as participants, not observers.
graphic-design.body: From the texture of a vinyl sleeve to the urgency of a last-minute flyer, we know what works because we have lived it. Every project gets the same attention, whether it is a global release or a Tuesday night event.
aside: Cover artwork for internationally released records with Grammy-nominated artists.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: You tell us what you need and when you need it, and we agree the timing together.

steps.title: Concepts
steps.text: We present 2 to 3 different directions to choose from.

steps.title: Refinement
steps.text: One round of revisions is included; most clients need zero.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Final files in every format you will ever need.

services.title: Vinyl & Album Covers
services.text: Artwork that holds its own next to the music. We handle concept, illustration, typography, and print-ready production for physical and digital releases.

services.title: Event Flyers & Posters
services.text: Bold, scroll-stopping visuals for club nights, festivals, residencies, and pop-ups. Designed for Instagram grids, stories, print, and LED screens.

services.title: Social Media Systems
services.text: Not one-off posts but entire visual systems. Templates, grids, story frameworks, and content calendars that keep your brand consistent across platforms.

services.title: Brand Collateral
services.text: Business cards, letterheads, presentation decks, menus, signage, and packaging. Every touchpoint reinforces your identity.

faqs.q: What types of graphic design do you offer?
faqs.a: We specialise in vinyl and album cover art, event flyers and posters, social media content systems, brand collateral, editorial layouts, and merchandise design. If it is visual and it matters, we design it.

Absolutely. We have designed covers for internationally released records including collaborations with Grammy-nominated artists. We understand print specifications, Pantone requirements, and the creative expectations of the music industry.

faqs.q: Do you work with event promoters?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with promoters, venues, and artists across Dubai and internationally. From weekly residency flyers to full festival campaigns, we deliver on tight timelines without cutting corners on quality.

app-development.title: App Development
app-development.subtitle: From concept to App Store. Mobile experiences that people actually want to use.
app-development.lede: The app graveyard is full of technically sound products that nobody wanted. We start with the problem, not the technology.
app-development.body: We design for humans first and write code second, because a beautiful interface on a broken idea is still a broken idea. We have taken apps from napkin sketches to the App Store. We know what it takes, and more importantly, we know what to cut.
aside: One team, first sketch to release build.
UX research, interface design, front-end and back-end architecture, and store deployment, all under one roof. Most projects ship from a single React Native codebase to both platforms.

phases.title: Discovery & Strategy
phases.text: We map your users, your competitors, and your business model. We define the MVP scope ruthlessly: ship what matters, learn from real users, iterate.

phases.title: UX & UI Design
phases.text: Wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity prototypes. You interact with the app before it is built. We validate assumptions early so we do not waste your budget.

phases.title: Development & Testing
phases.text: Agile sprints with bi-weekly demos. React Native for cross-platform efficiency, native modules where performance demands it. Continuous integration, automated testing.

phases.title: Launch & Growth
phases.text: App Store and Google Play submission, ASO optimisation, analytics setup, crash monitoring. Post-launch, we iterate based on real user data.

faqs.q: Do you build iOS and Android apps?
faqs.a: Yes. We build for both platforms. For most projects we use React Native, which allows us to ship a single codebase to both the App Store and Google Play without sacrificing performance or native feel.
We follow a four-phase process: Discovery and strategy, UX and UI design, development with iterative testing, and deployment with App Store optimisation. You are involved at every milestone.
